style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Christmas Artificial Olive & Cone Garland
style.toneOfVoice: Bring a touch of woodland charm to your home with this artificial 150cm olive & cone garland. Featuring lifelike olive leaves intertwined with rustic pinecones, it creates a beautifully textured display that’s perfect for festive or everyday décor. Ideal for draping across mantels, staircases, tables, or doorways, this garland adds warmth and elegance to any space. Its natural tones and realistic detailing make it a versatile accent, blending seamlessly with both contemporary and traditional interiors. Lightweight, flexible, and easy to style, it’s perfect for creating layered arrangements or standalone displays. Infuse your home with cosy beauty with this 150cm olive and cone garland—a timeless addition to your décor collection. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Garland Length: 150cm.
